description: [LocalSim L4] trading_core/ledger.py InMemoryLedger: (a) cash/notional/fee are float with a 1e-8 epsilon overdraft guard (115) -> drift accumulates in the authoritative carried-forward cash_after on 8-figure accounts and the epsilon masks small overdrafts / rejects valid boundary orders. (b) the 5-yuan minimum commission is applied per Fill (32), but the live path produces many fills per order across minute bars -> up to N x 5 overcharge vs the real per-ORDER A-share minimum. (c) no board-lot (100-share) enforcement at apply_fill. FIX: move cash/notional/fee to Decimal with explicit quantization and drop the 1e-8 epsilon; apply the min commission per order (incremental = max(0, order_min_or_rate_so_far - already_charged)); enforce 100-share board-lot at apply_fill (odd-lot only for full-position sells), fail loud otherwise. MiniQMT untouched.
